title: Rectangular bar
spec: Create a new coordinate system by setting the Euler angles to negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees. Set the translation vector to zero, zero, and zero. Begin by creating a new face and draw a closed loop consisting of four lines. The first line starts at zero, zero and ends at zero point zero seven five, zero. The second line starts at zero point zero seven five, zero and ends at zero point zero seven five, zero point zero three seven five. The third line starts at zero point zero seven five, zero point zero three seven five and ends at zero, zero point zero three seven five. The fourth line starts at zero, zero point zero three seven five and ends at zero, zero. Apply a scaling factor of zero point zero seven five to the sketch. Rotate the sketch using the Euler angles negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees. Translate the sketch using the translation vector zero, zero, and zero. Extrude the sketch zero point seven five units in the direction of the normal, ensuring no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction of the normal. This operation creates a new solid body. The final shape is a rectangular bar with a uniform cross-section and straight edges. The dimensions of the rectangular bar are: length zero point zero seven five units, width zero point zero three seven five units, and height zero point seven five units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.075, 0).lineTo(0.075, 0.0375).lineTo(0, 0.0375).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extruded = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90, 0, -90) and the translation vector is (0, 0, 0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the model 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
transformed = extruded.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = transformed

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.075, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.075, 0.0375) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0375) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90, 0, -90) and the translation vector is (0, 0, 0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the model 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.075) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.075) \

     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular bar
r = r.extrude(0.0375)
